Messages.Body:
On VTES-L, Dave Stevers <daves...@HOTMAIL.COM> wrote:
> Stolen blood - If a vampire has 1 blood in combat, steals
> 2 blood and takes 2 agg, does he burn or end up in torpor with 1 blood?

He steals the blood and takes the damage *before* attempting to
heal damage or prevent destruction from agg damage.

At this point, the vampire will have three blood (assuming his
capacity is at least three - otherwise the excess drains off).

Then he can use that blood to prevent destruction, leaving him with
one blood (and in torpor).

> Aching Beauty, Anarch Revolt, and Archon: are they cumulative?
> Does Donal's ability happen on top of Camm. Exemplary and Archon?
> Or do they just end up being lumped together? (non cumulative)

All cumulative, and they stack with each other as well (they are not
just lumped together).

> Strained vitae supply - does this mean that vampires cannot add stealth
> to hunting actions or do vampires just get 0 stealth?

THey can add stealth - the action just has a base 0 stealth (instead
of the normal +1 stealth).

> Anathema - what effect does Catatonic Fear's damage and
> Mariel's ability have on this card? They both happen after combat ends,
> does that mean Anathema's effect does not kick in?

Both CataFear and Mariel deal their damage after combat, so that
damage won't attract the attention of Anathema.
